purpose: One keyboard map for both lanes: conflict-free, browser-safe, and the doc regenerated from it.

keystrokes.name: P toggles the pen
Enter finishes a line in the pen
Enter outside the pen does nothing
arrow with nothing selected turns the camera
Shift+arrow still turns the camera (5° step)
arrow with a point selected is not the camera
arrow with a point selected nudges once Phase B lands
? opens the sheet regardless of Shift
Shift+E exports pen lines
plain E is nothing
Shift+F flattens when the pattern block is up
plain F faces the point
⌘Z on macOS is undo once Phase B lands
Ctrl+Z on macOS is not ours (Ctrl+click is a right-click there)
Ctrl+Z elsewhere is undo once Phase B lands
a keystroke in a text field is the field's
L is unknown to the production lane
L opens landmarks in the prototype
Home resets the view
Space is nothing until Phase C

checks.name: every binding has a unique id
every binding has a label and at least one key
every binding names a known context
no keystroke can mean two things at once
checks.detail: within a tool, and between each tool and the always layer

checks.name: no binding takes a browser-owned ⌘/Ctrl combination
checks.detail: ⌘/Ctrl + S P W N T L D F R H J K O U Q E left to the browser

checks.name: the platform modifier is used only for undo/redo
Shift+letter only produces a file or runs a solve
the dispatcher resolves the representative keystrokes
the sheet lists active rows of the active contexts for the lane
